record.interface_detail: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible. The platform is served by the first-party Zhipu inference API, with chat at POST https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/chat/completions and models at GET https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/models; auth is a bearer key in Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY, created on the API Keys page after sign-in, with a JWT Token scheme also documented. GLM Coding Plan uses separate base URLs and separate keys.

The sandbox and runtime environment are '限时免费至 2026 年 10 月 31 日' (free for a limited time until 2026-10-31), and Web Search / Web Fetch tool calls are '工具调用费用限时免费至 2026 年 10 月 31 日，之后按调用收费；模型 token 费用仍产生' (free until 2026-10-31, then charged per call, with model token fees still incurred). The platform drives the loop and emits session.status_idle when a round ends, Memory mounts into several sessions with audited changes, and cron creates new sessions on schedule.
